focus: Angle 2 — routing artifact parity, sk-code and cli-external-orchestration hubs

findingDetails.title: cli-external-orchestration ROUTER.md omits the seventh registered mode cli-hermes in all three roster statements
findingDetails.evidence: ROUTER.md:24-25 lists six modes with no cli-hermes; :38-46 opens the INTENT MODEL and supplies exactly six per-mode bullets (grep -c '^- **cli-' returns 6); :143-144 closes with the same six names; lines 1-70 contain zero hermes mentions. mode-registry.json registers seven including cli-hermes as packetKind workflow, hub-router.json carries seven routerSignals and cli-hermes in tieBreak, leaf-manifest.json carries a nine-leaf cli-hermes entry, SKILL.md:31 carries a cli-hermes mode-table row, and this same ROUTER.md's RESOURCE_MAP carries a HERMES key with two cli-hermes paths.
findingDetails.impact: The document this hub names as its stage-two routing authority routes a mode in its machine block while its human-facing contract states the mode does not exist, so the newest registered mode has no described intent model or leaf set.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add cli-hermes to all three ROUTER.md roster statements and its intent-model bullet. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Counted per-mode intent bullets programmatically, grepped lines 1-70 for hermes, and cross-read registry, hub-router, leaf-manifest, SKILL.md mode table and ROUTER.md's own RESOURCE_MAP.

findingDetails.title: cli-external-orchestration SKILL.md:74 says all six modes against seven in the same file and five other statements
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:74 says ROUTER.md defines the leaf-intent model for all six modes, while SKILL.md:3, :15, :54 and :190 say seven, README.md says seven five times, and description.json:3 enumerates all seven by name. A regex count of mode-count phrases returned seven/four times against six/once.
findingDetails.impact: A reader of the hub's routing prose receives a roster size that contradicts the hub's own registry, mode table and description.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the six-to-seven in the ROUTER.md description sentence as part of the F007 fix. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Regular-expression extracted every mode-count phrase in SKILL.md, README.md and ROUTER.md rather than reading for one, then compared against the registry roster.

findingDetails.title: cli-external-orchestration splits the mode-registry/hub-router version pair that sk-code keeps in parity
findingDetails.evidence: cli mode-registry.json=1.2.0.2 vs hub-router.json=1.2.1.2 (differ); sk-code mode-registry.json=4.1.0.1 vs hub-router.json=4.1.0.1 (match). The SKILL.md/description.json pair matches in both hubs (cli 1.5.0.0/1.5.0.0; sk-code 4.2.2.0/4.2.2.0), isolating the divergence to one pair on one hub.
findingDetails.impact: Completes the fleet version matrix begun in iteration 1: system-deep-loop splits both pairs, cli-external-orchestration splits one, and sk-code the reference hub splits neither.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either bring this pair into parity or introduce the single shared generation field F001 proposes. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all five version-bearing artifacts in all three hubs as a matrix rather than comparing one pair in isolation.

findingDetails.title: cli-hermes leaf set carries a lane-unique reference no ROUTER.md sentence describes
findingDetails.evidence: ROUTER.md:40-44 and :139-143 describe each mode's first slice and its on-demand providers-and-models.md catalog. cli-hermes's manifest entry carries references/mcp-policy.md, a file no other CLI mode's leaf set contains and no sentence in ROUTER.md accounts for.
findingDetails.impact: Advisory only: the map is explicitly a first slice, so the extra leaf is not a contract break, but the one reference unique to this lane is undescribed in the routing document.
findingDetails.recommendation: Have ROUTER.md either name the hermes MCP policy reference or state that lane-unique on-demand references are deliberately undescribed. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared all seven cli mode leaf sets member by member to find lane-unique references, then searched ROUTER.md prose for a sentence accounting for one.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Two hub routing-artifact sets of six and seven modes, cross-checked against a third hub as a parity control plus four compiled-routing compiler branches.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Angle 2 names both hubs by their seven routing artifacts, and the phase spec's cli-hermes claim makes the cli hub's stage-two router the highest-value single document.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The stage-two routing document describes every mode the hub registers.

searchActions.queryOrPath: per-mode intent bullets and roster statements in ROUTER.md against the registry roster
searchActions.result: Six bullets and three six-name roster statements; no cli-hermes anywhere in lines 1-70, while the same document's RESOURCE_MAP carries HERMES.

searchLedger.rationale: A live registered mode is absent from every human-facing roster statement in the document that owns leaf routing.

searchLedger.invariant: Every mode-count phrase inside one document agrees with the registry roster.

searchActions.queryOrPath: regex extraction of every count phrase in SKILL.md, README.md and ROUTER.md
searchActions.result: SKILL.md returns seven four times and six once; README.md returns seven five times.

searchLedger.rationale: The single six describes the artifact that is itself stuck at six, making this the prose face of the same stale edit.

searchLedger.invariant: The registry/router version pair holds the same relationship in every hub.

searchActions.queryOrPath: version fields of five artifacts in all three hubs as a matrix
searchActions.result: cli splits the registry/router pair while sk-code matches it; both hubs match on SKILL/description.

searchLedger.rationale: Isolates the divergence to one pair on one hub against a reference hub that keeps both pairs.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Every lane-unique reference is accounted for by the routing document.

searchActions.queryOrPath: compare all seven cli mode leaf sets member by member for lane-unique members
searchActions.result: cli-hermes is the only lane with references/mcp-policy.md, which no ROUTER.md sentence describes.

searchLedger.rationale: Real but advisory, since the map is a declared first slice and the file may be intentionally undescribed.

searchLedger.invariant: A hub's four roster-bearing artifacts name the same modes in the same order.

searchActions.queryOrPath: sk-code registry vs hub tieBreak vs routerSignals vs leaf-manifest vs SKILL.md table
searchActions.result: Six modes identical across all four artifacts; tieBreak and routerSignals order equal to registry order.

searchLedger.rationale: sk-code passes every roster property and stands as the parity baseline for the fleet.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: All four roster artifacts agree with the registry in content and order.

searchLedger.invariant: Every registry alias is visible to the hub's scoring vocabulary.

searchActions.queryOrPath: per-mode registry aliases minus hub-router vocabularyClasses keywords
searchActions.result: Zero registry-only terms across all seven modes.

searchLedger.rationale: The alias-recall defect found on system-deep-loop does not reproduce on the cli hub.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Empty set difference for all seven modes.

searchLedger.hypothesis: ROUTER.md INTENT_SIGNALS covers only a subset of modes.

searchActions.queryOrPath: re-parse the INTENT_SIGNALS block to its closing brace
searchActions.result: Seven signal keys; the earlier single-key reading was a parser artifact from a nested brace.

searchLedger.rationale: The block is complete and matches the seven RESOURCE_MAP keys; the initial signal was a parsing error, not a defect.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Full block re-parsed to the closing brace and confirmed to carry seven entries.

searchLedger.hypothesis: cli leaf entries contain leaves belonging to other packets.

searchActions.queryOrPath: test each leaf against its own packet root
searchActions.result: An initial hub-relative check flagged 65 leaves; leaves are packet-root-relative, so re-tested against the packet root every entry is own-packet.

searchLedger.rationale: The contamination was an artifact of my own path assumption, not of the manifest.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Corrected the check to the packet-root convention and confirmed zero foreign leaves.

searchLedger.invariant: Two workflow modes sharing one packet still carry distinct leaf sets.

searchActions.queryOrPath: packet-to-mode grouping across all three hubs
searchActions.result: sk-code is 6 modes to 6 packets and cli is 7 to 7; the only N-to-1 group in the fleet is system-deep-loop's improvement pair.

searchLedger.rationale: Neither hub under this angle contains an N-to-1 fan-out group.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Grouping found no packet carrying more than one workflow mode in either hub.
